analysis:
Examined SSDPrefixCache.swift BASE 1838–2193 and HEAD 1–656 against the canonical index and supplied T-041 details. These excerpts are unchanged according to the complete range map. Startup scanning rejects unsafe paths and incompatible bindings; durable receipts require bounded authenticated reads with weight/layout/block/tag checks. HEAD lookup preserves salt-derived HMAC identities, epoch checks, layer-layout validation and request-specific staging pins; endAdoption and shutdown release per-entry reservations. No supported regression in confidentiality, authorization or receipt integrity is visible in these units.
The actual change at HEAD 1773–1778 delegates LRU eviction to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest, replacing the BASE victim loop. Its implementation is not supplied here, so equivalence is unresolved rather than a finding. Integration must inspect that helper with retireIndexedEntries and SSDDiskBudget: preserve bounded victim traversal, skipping undeletable entries, index reconciliation, external-change handling and accurate freed-byte accounting. These contracts materially affect T-041's disk-budget mitigation and provider availability (A-018). The supplied excerpts do not establish a change to encryption, authenticated account scoping, TTL, attestation or billing.
